claims.text: Healing may occur spontaneously; minocycline or doxycycline, clarithromycin, or rifampin + ethambutol for 3 to 6 months have been effective.
claims.quote: Healing may occur spontaneously, but minocycline or doxycycline 100 to 200 mg orally once/day, clarithromycin 500 mg orally 2 times a day, or rifampin (rifampicin) plus ethambutol for 3 to 6 months have been effective against M. marinum.
